preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of flights m must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi in flights)
preconditions.description: Each flight must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.
The number of flights provided must match the specified number m.

postconditions.description: Output 'No' if it is impossible to adjust flight durations, otherwise output 'Yes'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ansi <= 2 for ansi in durations)
postconditions.description: Each flight duration must be either 1 or 2 hours.
The number of output durations must match the number of flights.
